summary: Rigel Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing a license agreement with Arvinas and Pfizer for VEPPANU (vepdegestrant), an approved breast cancer treatment. Rigel pays $70M upfront, $15M on transition completion, up to $320M in milestones, and tiered mid-teens to mid-twenties royalties. This is an in-licensing deal, not an acquisition or special-situation M&A event. The filing describes a product licensing arrangement, not a change of control, activist campaign, or restructuring. No deal terms for special-situation classification are present; the agreement is a routine material definitive agreement for a biotech licensing transaction.
